target: next fiscal year card volume falls >= 50% or merchant disappears (proxy for credit distress)
findings: Monthly volume volatility alone ranks almost as well as the full model: revenue volatility is the dominant early-warning driver in this data.
Volume decline alone ranks below chance: after a decline volume tends to recover, and growth years are followed by falls (mean reversion), so a naive 'shrinking merchant' rule fails here.
Merchants almost never disappear in this dataset, so the target is a revenue collapse, not an exit.
